source_quote: Providers and deployers of AI systems shall take measures to support the development of AI literacy of their staff
summary_en: Take measures to support the AI literacy of staff who operate or use AI systems on your behalf. No specific level must be guaranteed.
summary_sv: Vidta åtgärder som stödjer AI-kunnigheten hos personal som driver eller använder AI-system för er räkning. Ingen viss nivå behöver garanteras.

source_quote: Providers and deployers of AI systems shall take measures to support the development of AI literacy of their staff
summary_en: Take measures to support the AI literacy of staff who operate or use AI systems on your behalf. No specific level must be guaranteed.
summary_sv: Vidta åtgärder som stödjer AI-kunnigheten hos personal som driver eller använder AI-system för er räkning. Ingen viss nivå behöver garanteras.

source_quote: The following AI practices shall be prohibited:
summary_en: Do not place on the market or put into service AI systems for the practices listed in Article 5.
summary_sv: Släpp inte ut eller ta i bruk AI-system för de metoder som räknas upp i artikel 5.

source_quote: The following AI practices shall be prohibited:
summary_en: Do not use AI systems for the practices listed in Article 5.
summary_sv: Använd inte AI-system för de metoder som räknas upp i artikel 5.

source_quote: A provider who considers that an AI system referred to in Annex III is not high-risk shall document its assessment before that system is placed on the market or put into service.
summary_en: If you conclude that an Annex III system is not high-risk under Article 6(3), document that assessment before the system is placed on the market.
summary_sv: Om ni bedömer att ett system i bilaga III inte är högrisk enligt artikel 6.3 ska bedömningen dokumenteras innan systemet släpps ut.

source_quote: A risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems.
summary_en: Run a documented risk management process across the whole lifecycle of the system.
summary_sv: Ha en dokumenterad riskhanteringsprocess under systemets hela livscykel.

source_quote: High-risk AI systems which make use of techniques involving the training of AI models with data shall be developed on the basis of training, validation and testing data sets that meet the quality criteria
summary_en: Train, validate and test on data sets that meet the quality and governance criteria of Article 10.
summary_sv: Träna, validera och testa på datamängder som uppfyller kvalitets- och styrningskraven i artikel 10.

source_quote: The technical documentation of a high-risk AI system shall be drawn up before that system is placed on the market or put into service and shall be kept up-to date.
summary_en: Draw up technical documentation (Annex IV) before placing the system on the market, and keep it up to date.
summary_sv: Upprätta teknisk dokumentation (bilaga IV) innan systemet släpps ut, och håll den aktuell.

source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system.
summary_en: Build in automatic event logging over the lifetime of the system.
summary_sv: Bygg in automatisk händelseloggning under systemets livstid.

source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way as to ensure that their operation is sufficiently transparent to enable deployers to interpret a system’s output and use it appropriately.
summary_en: Make the system transparent enough for deployers to interpret its output, and provide clear instructions for use.
summary_sv: Gör systemet så transparent att användarna kan tolka resultaten, och ge tydliga bruksanvisningar.

source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.
summary_en: Design the system so that people can effectively oversee it while it is in use.
summary_sv: Utforma systemet så att människor effektivt kan övervaka det medan det används.

source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity
summary_en: Achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity throughout the lifecycle.
summary_sv: Uppnå lämplig noggrannhet, robusthet och cybersäkerhet under hela livscykeln.

source_quote: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall put a quality management system in place that ensures compliance with this Regulation.
summary_en: Put a documented quality management system in place.
summary_sv: Inför ett dokumenterat kvalitetsledningssystem.

source_quote: The provider shall, for a period ending 10 years after the high-risk AI system has been placed on the market or put into service, keep at the disposal of the national competent authorities:
summary_en: Keep the documentation available to authorities for 10 years after placing on the market.
summary_sv: Håll dokumentationen tillgänglig för myndigheterna i 10 år efter utsläppandet.

source_quote: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs referred to in Article 12(1), automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems, to the extent such logs are under their control.
summary_en: Keep the automatically generated logs under your control for at least six months.
summary_sv: Spara de automatiskt genererade loggar ni kontrollerar i minst sex månader.

source_quote: shall immediately take the necessary corrective actions to bring that system into conformity, to withdraw it, to disable it, or to recall it, as appropriate.
summary_en: Correct, withdraw, disable or recall a non-conforming system immediately, and inform the value chain.
summary_sv: Rätta, dra tillbaka, stäng av eller återkalla ett system som inte uppfyller kraven omedelbart, och informera kedjan.

source_quote: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall, upon a reasoned request by a competent authority, provide that authority all the information and documentation necessary
summary_en: Give a competent authority the information it needs to assess conformity, on reasoned request.
summary_sv: Lämna behörig myndighet den information som behövs för att bedöma överensstämmelse, på motiverad begäran.

source_quote: Prior to making their high-risk AI systems available on the Union market, providers established in third countries shall, by written mandate, appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union.
summary_en: Providers outside the EU appoint an authorised representative in the EU by written mandate.
summary_sv: Leverantörer utanför EU utser ett ombud i EU genom skriftlig fullmakt.

source_quote: ensure that the high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure as referred to in Article 43, prior to its being placed on the market or put into service
summary_en: Have the system go through the conformity assessment of Article 43 before placing it on the market.
summary_sv: Låt systemet genomgå bedömningen av överensstämmelse enligt artikel 43 innan det släpps ut.

source_quote: The provider shall draw up a written machine readable, physical or electronically signed EU declaration of conformity for each high-risk AI system
summary_en: Draw up an EU declaration of conformity for each high-risk system and keep it for 10 years.
summary_sv: Upprätta en EU-försäkran om överensstämmelse för varje högrisksystem och spara den i 10 år.

source_quote: affix the CE marking to the high-risk AI system
summary_en: Affix the CE marking (digital for digitally provided systems).
summary_sv: Anbringa CE-märkningen (digital för system som tillhandahålls digitalt).

source_quote: the provider or, where applicable, the authorised representative shall register themselves and their system in the EU database
summary_en: Register yourself and Annex III systems in the EU database before placing them on the market (point 2 systems at national level).
summary_sv: Registrera er och system i bilaga III i EU-databasen innan de släpps ut (system enligt punkt 2 nationellt).

source_quote: Before placing on the market or putting into service an AI system for which the provider has concluded that it is not high-risk according to Article 6(3), that provider or, where applicable, the authorised representative shall register themselves and that system in the EU database referred to in Article 71.
summary_en: Annex III systems you have assessed as not high-risk are still registered in the EU database.
summary_sv: System i bilaga III som ni bedömt inte vara högrisk registreras ändå i EU-databasen.

source_quote: Providers shall establish and document a post-market monitoring system in a manner that is proportionate to the nature of the AI technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system.
summary_en: Monitor the system after placing it on the market, under a documented plan.
summary_sv: Övervaka systemet efter utsläppandet enligt en dokumenterad plan.

source_quote: Providers of high-risk AI systems placed on the Union market shall report any serious incident to the market surveillance authorities of the Member States where that incident occurred.
summary_en: Report serious incidents to the market surveillance authority, at the latest within 15 days of becoming aware.
summary_sv: Rapportera allvarliga incidenter till marknadskontrollmyndigheten, senast inom 15 dagar efter att ni fått kännedom.

source_quote: Before placing a high-risk AI system on the market, importers shall ensure that the system is in conformity with this Regulation by verifying that:
summary_en: Before placing a system on the market, verify conformity assessment, documentation, CE marking and authorised representative.
summary_sv: Kontrollera bedömning av överensstämmelse, dokumentation, CE-märkning och ombud innan systemet släpps ut.

source_quote: Before making a high-risk AI system available on the market, distributors shall verify that it bears the required CE marking
summary_en: Before making a system available, check CE marking, declaration of conformity and instructions for use.
summary_sv: Kontrollera CE-märkning, försäkran om överensstämmelse och bruksanvisning innan systemet tillhandahålls.

source_quote: Any distributor, importer, deployer or other third-party shall be considered to be a provider of a high-risk AI system for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16
summary_en: Rebranding, substantially modifying or repurposing a system into high-risk can make you its provider.
summary_sv: Den som sätter sitt namn på, väsentligt ändrar eller ändrar syftet med ett system så att det blir högrisk kan bli dess leverantör.

source_quote: Any distributor, importer, deployer or other third-party shall be considered to be a provider of a high-risk AI system for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16
summary_en: Rebranding, substantially modifying or repurposing a system into high-risk can make you its provider.
summary_sv: Den som sätter sitt namn på, väsentligt ändrar eller ändrar syftet med ett system så att det blir högrisk kan bli dess leverantör.

source_quote: Any distributor, importer, deployer or other third-party shall be considered to be a provider of a high-risk AI system for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to the obligations of the provider under Article 16
summary_en: Rebranding, substantially modifying or repurposing a system into high-risk can make you its provider.
summary_sv: Den som sätter sitt namn på, väsentligt ändrar eller ändrar syftet med ett system så att det blir högrisk kan bli dess leverantör.

source_quote: Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall take appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure they use such systems in accordance with the instructions for use accompanying the systems
summary_en: Use the system according to its instructions for use.
summary_sv: Använd systemet enligt bruksanvisningen.

source_quote: Deployers shall assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority, as well as the necessary support.
summary_en: Assign human oversight to competent, trained people with the authority to act.
summary_sv: Låt kompetenta och utbildade personer med befogenhet att agera övervaka systemet.

source_quote: Deployers shall monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions for use
summary_en: Monitor the system in operation; on a risk or serious incident, inform the provider and the authority, and suspend use where required.
summary_sv: Övervaka systemet i drift; vid risk eller allvarlig incident, informera leverantören och myndigheten och avbryt användningen när det krävs.

source_quote: Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under their control
summary_en: Keep the logs under your control for at least six months.
summary_sv: Spara de loggar ni kontrollerar i minst sex månader.

source_quote: Before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system at the workplace, deployers who are employers shall inform workers’ representatives and the affected workers
summary_en: Employers inform workers and their representatives before using a high-risk system at the workplace.
summary_sv: Arbetsgivare informerar arbetstagare och deras företrädare innan ett högrisksystem används på arbetsplatsen.

source_quote: shall perform an assessment of the impact on fundamental rights
summary_en: Public bodies, private providers of public services, and deployers of credit-scoring and insurance-pricing systems assess the impact on fundamental rights before first use.
summary_sv: Offentliga organ, privata aktörer som tillhandahåller offentliga tjänster och användare av system för kreditprövning och försäkringsprissättning bedömer påverkan på grundläggande rättigheter före första användningen.

source_quote: deployers that are public authorities, Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies or persons acting on their behalf shall register themselves
summary_en: Public-authority deployers register their use of Annex III systems in the EU database.
summary_sv: Myndigheter som använder system i bilaga III registrerar användningen i EU-databasen.

source_quote: Providers shall ensure that AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons are designed and developed in such a way that the natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system
summary_en: Tell people they are interacting with an AI system, unless it is obvious.
summary_sv: Informera människor om att de interagerar med ett AI-system, om det inte är uppenbart.

source_quote: shall ensure that the outputs of the AI system are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated.
summary_en: Mark generated audio, image, video and text in a machine-readable way so it can be detected as AI-generated.
summary_sv: Märk genererat ljud, bild, video och text maskinläsbart så att det kan upptäckas som AI-genererat.

source_quote: Deployers of an emotion recognition system or a biometric categorisation system shall inform the natural persons exposed thereto of the operation of the system
summary_en: Inform people exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation.
summary_sv: Informera människor som utsätts för känsloigenkänning eller biometrisk kategorisering.

source_quote: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake, shall disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated.
summary_en: Disclose that deep fakes are AI-generated (limited for evidently artistic or satirical work).
summary_sv: Upplys om att deepfakes är AI-genererade (begränsat för uppenbart konstnärliga eller satiriska verk).

source_quote: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest shall disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated.
summary_en: Disclose AI-generated text published to inform the public, unless it has had human editorial review.
summary_sv: Upplys om AI-genererad text som publiceras för att informera allmänheten, om den inte granskats redaktionellt.

source_quote: draw up and keep up-to-date the technical documentation of the model, including its training and testing process and the results of its evaluation
summary_en: Keep technical documentation of the model (Annex XI) for the AI Office and authorities.
summary_sv: Håll teknisk dokumentation av modellen (bilaga XI) för AI-byrån och myndigheterna.

source_quote: draw up, keep up-to-date and make available information and documentation to providers of AI systems who intend to integrate the general-purpose AI model into their AI systems.
summary_en: Give downstream providers the information they need to integrate the model (Annex XII).
summary_sv: Ge leverantörer i senare led den information de behöver för att bygga in modellen (bilaga XII).

source_quote: put in place a policy to comply with Union law on copyright and related rights
summary_en: Have a policy to comply with EU copyright law, including text-and-data-mining opt-outs.
summary_sv: Ha en policy för att följa EU:s upphovsrätt, inklusive förbehåll mot text- och datautvinning.

source_quote: draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary about the content used for training of the general-purpose AI model, according to a template provided by the AI Office.
summary_en: Publish a summary of the training content, using the AI Office template.
summary_sv: Publicera en sammanfattning av träningsinnehållet enligt AI-byråns mall.

source_quote: Prior to placing a general-purpose AI model on the Union market, providers established in third countries shall, by written mandate, appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union.
summary_en: Providers outside the EU appoint an authorised representative in the EU.
summary_sv: Leverantörer utanför EU utser ett ombud i EU.

source_quote: perform model evaluation in accordance with standardised protocols and tools reflecting the state of the art, including conducting and documenting adversarial testing of the model
summary_en: Evaluate the model with state-of-the-art protocols, including documented adversarial testing.
summary_sv: Utvärdera modellen med moderna protokoll, inklusive dokumenterad adversariell testning.

source_quote: assess and mitigate possible systemic risks at Union level
summary_en: Assess and mitigate systemic risks at Union level.
summary_sv: Bedöm och minska systemrisker på unionsnivå.

source_quote: keep track of, document, and report, without undue delay, to the AI Office and, as appropriate, to national competent authorities, relevant information about serious incidents
summary_en: Track and report serious incidents to the AI Office without undue delay.
summary_sv: Följ upp och rapportera allvarliga incidenter till AI-byrån utan onödigt dröjsmål.

source_quote: ensure an adequate level of cybersecurity protection for the general-purpose AI model with systemic risk and the physical infrastructure of the model.
summary_en: Protect the model and its physical infrastructure with adequate cybersecurity.
summary_sv: Skydda modellen och dess fysiska infrastruktur med tillräcklig cybersäkerhet.
